issues.description: In Exercise 1 the template defines a method named build_grover(...) but the rest of the artifacts (the template's run() and the solution) use the name grover_circuit(...). The problem statement's task label and tests refer to building a Grover circuit (test_ex1_grover_circuit). This inconsistent naming (build_grover vs grover_circuit) creates a direct mapping confusion for students: they may correctly implement the stub named build_grover while the runner/tests (and the template run method) expect grover_circuit, causing errors and extra debugging unrelated to the learning objective.
issues.suggested_fix: Unify the method name across artifacts. Rename the template method build_grover(...) to grover_circuit(...) (including its docstring) so it matches the solution and the run() call and aligns with the problem/test name (test_ex1_grover_circuit). Alternatively, change the run() call to invoke build_grover(...), but prefer grover_circuit to match tests and solution.
